playback_flow: Known providers now prefer the relocated original Drama World Q0/S0 extractor before generic public-page parsing. The chosen R0/a URL is decoded and handed directly to MX. A final .m3u8 is not fetched a second time before MX.
quality_flow: Original extractor quality labels are retained and a multi-quality result is shown before player handoff.
download_flow: Episode download routing follows the original type switch: mp4 direct; mkv/mov/m3u8/webm go through the original extractor. TDM/1DM intent MIME, secure_uri, referer/cookie extras and HLS .ts filename behavior were aligned with the supplied V4.2f APK.
guest_access_rule: No local account gate is invented for the supplied V4.2f guest paths; real remote authentication remains enforced by the provider if present.
known_limitations: The original app also loads protected dynamic provider regex/prefix/hlsuri/header configuration. Those protected values are not available in this repository, so providers that depend on them can still fail even though the original Q0/S0 bytecode is included. This APK requires real-device testing against the user's working servers.
